barak_arrives.text:

mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your presence is His gift to him.

The army watches you for a sign.

credit_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] No sword of yours broke them.
Lift His name above your own.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow your head in song.

ending_faithful.text:
